title: Rank-and-Reason: Multi-Agent Collaboration Accelerates Zero-Shot Protein Mutation Prediction (VenusRAR)
authors: Yang Tan, Yuanxi Yu, Can Wu, Bozitao Zhong, Mingchen Li, Guisheng Fan, Jiankang Zhu, Yafeng Liang, Nanqing Dong, Liang Hong
plm_baselines: VenusRAR-Ensemble (unweighted 6-expert mean: VenusREM, ProSST-2048, SaProt-AF650M, ProtSSN-Ensemble, GEMME, ESM-IF1)
code_and_data_released: GitHub link stated in abstract, but Appendix C/D system prompts, Cas12i3 agent logs, and exact Cas12i3 mutation identities/raw assay values are withheld ('Updated upon paper acceptance').

methods.datasets: ProteinGym substitutions (217 assays, 2,465,767 mutations), ProteinGym-DMS99 (31 assays with >99% single-mutant coverage), and wet-lab Cas12i3 nuclease (1,045 aa, 30 single-point mutants).
methods.evaluation_protocol: Rank-Stage profiles protein metadata/MSA Neff/pLDDT and writes Python dynamic weighting over 6 specialized predictors; Reason-Stage pools top 200 variants per model (<=1,400) and audits ranks, pLDDT, RSA, charge, and position diversity. Standalone LLMs also tested zero-shot and 10/20/30-shot.
methods.controls_included: Unweighted 6-expert mean (VenusRAR-Ensemble), standalone LLM zero-shot/few-shot, and random selection. Missing: non-LLM learned meta-ensemble, deterministic biophysical/diversity filter, and wet-lab Cas12i3 control arm.
methods.compute_and_tools: Orchestrates 6 specialized pLM/structure/MSA models plus AlphaFold2 pLDDT/RSA/charge and consumes ~249M LLM tokens across ProteinGym (~912k output tokens/protein, Table 7).
methods.metrics: Spearman rho (ProteinGym 217); Normalized Max Score, Top 1/5/10% precision, and Top-K hit rate (DMS99); HEK293T EGxxFP fluorescence fold-change (Cas12i3).
methods.wet_lab_protocol: 30 single-point Cas12i3 mutants tested in HEK293T cells via EGxxFP fluorescence ratio normalized to WT=1.0; no control arm from unweighted ensemble or single pLM.

key_results.notes: Clean demonstration that a standalone reasoning LLM (0.159) sits far below single-sequence pLMs (0.414) and specialist ensembles (0.542); also below random on DMS99 Max at N=40.

key_results.benchmark: ProteinGym 217, DMS99 (31 assays, N=30), and wet-lab Cas12i3 (N=30)
key_results.llm_score: 0.551 Spearman (+0.009 over 0.542 ensemble); DMS99 N=30 Max 68.42% & Hit@5 4.52; Cas12i3 14/30 (46.7%) >WT (up to 5.05x)
key_results.baseline_model: Unweighted 6-expert ensemble (no non-LLM diversity/biophysical filter tested)
key_results.baseline_score: 0.542 Spearman; DMS99 N=30 Max 62.22% & Hit@5 1.29; Cas12i3 control not run
key_results.notes: Almost all global ranking power (0.542 of 0.551) comes from the 6 specialized models; no non-LLM diversity/pLDDT filter baseline or Cas12i3 experimental control arm is run, and prompts/mutations are withheld.

temporal_cutoff.evidence: ProteinGym (2023/2024) predates all tested 2025/2026 LLMs with no post-cutoff holdout (though standalone LLMs score poorly at 0.159).

homology_overlap.evidence: No homology split against pLM or LLM training sets; Cas12i3 is called an orphan protein without reporting identity to engineered Cas12i variants cited in Appendix E.1.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: Rank-Stage supplies molecule name and taxon (Appendix C.1), adding text annotations boosts standalone LLM DMS99 precision (Table 14), and Cas12i3 engineering literature predates the study.

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Text claims '367% improvement' on Top-5 Hit Rate at N=40 where 4.73/1.29 = 3.67x (+267%) and Rank-Stage (5.38) actually beats Reason-Stage (4.73); Table 15 repeats identical 20-shot and 30-shot numbers; 1-8 failed error files/run (Table 12).

downstream_oracle_filtering.evidence: System re-weights and filters 6 SOTA specialized protein predictors whose unweighted average already reaches 0.542 Spearman.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: Uses 6 specialized models + AF2 pLDDT/RSA + 249M LLM tokens (~912k output tokens/protein) compared against single models.

baseline_fairness.evidence: No deterministic non-LLM diversity/biophysical heuristic filter or learned meta-ensemble baseline; Cas12i3 wet-lab assay has no pLM-only control arm.

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: System prompts (App C-D), Cas12i3 logs (App E.2), exact mutations, and per-variant raw fluorescence measurements are withheld.

takeaway: Standalone DeepSeek-Reasoner scores just 0.159 Spearman on ProteinGym (far behind ESM2-650M at 0.414), whereas an unweighted ensemble of six specialized models reaches 0.542 and LLM orchestration nudges it to 0.551 while improving low-N Top-K hit rates. Missing non-LLM heuristic filter controls, withheld prompts/mutant identities, and an uncontrolled Cas12i3 wet-lab arm leave the causal contribution of LLM reasoning unisolated.
